daily.today_energy: Your intuition is absolutely *chef's kiss* today. Mercury's vibes are giving you permission to trust that gut feeling that's been whispering. Time to lean into your natural magnetism and let people see the real you.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, there's a softness in the air around you. If you're seeing someone, honest conversations flow easier now. Single? Someone's definitely noticing your energy. Stay open but keep your standards.
daily.career: Your ideas hit different today—literally. That project or proposal you've been sitting on? The universe is nudging you to share it. Your voice carries weight right now, so speak up in meetings and trust your expertise.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance, not intensity. Maybe skip the hardcore workout and do something that feels good instead—yoga, a walk, stretching. Your nervous system will thank you for choosing calm over chaos today.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to shed what no longer serves. Mercury's movement suggests clarity is coming through honest conversations. Trust the timing—something you've been waiting for is closer than it feels.
weekly.love: Your vibe is magnetic rn. If you're single, someone's noticing the quiet confidence you're giving. Coupled up? This is peak moment to actually say the vulnerable things you've been holding back. Authenticity hits different.
weekly.career: The stars are whispering about leveling up your skills or pivoting how you present your ideas. Don't wait for permission to take up more space. Your unique perspective is literally what people need to hear right now.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week. Whether it's movement, time outside, or just unplugging—listen to that intuition. Energy flows where intention goes, so check in with what actually nourishes you versus what's just routine.
